FlowerPainter.Recipe.AdventurePlayground: Play zones by age round a shaded parents' hub: climbing, swings, splash pad, nature play on a mound.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.Name: Adventure playground
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.style.Tooltip: The signature of the playground: which zone leads the layout.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.ageZones.Tooltip: Separate zones for toddlers, juniors and teens (toddlers nearest the parents), one mixed zone, or toddler zones only.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.equipment.Tooltip: Total pieces of play equipment, shared between the play zones.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.clearance.Tooltip: Free fall space kept between pieces of equipment.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.ground.Tooltip: Ground under the equipment: sand, rubber-look paving, bark (dirt) or plain grass.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.waterPlay.Tooltip: A splash pad with jets and a chain of stepping pools.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.pools.Tooltip: Small water-look pools with stones, trailing away from the splash pad.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.naturePlay.Tooltip: Logs, boulders, a mound and a willow tunnel instead of manufactured equipment.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.mound.Tooltip: Raises a round mound in the nature zone, blended to the ground at its foot (permanent terrain change).
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.tunnel.Tooltip: Two rows of bushes forming a green tunnel to crawl and run through.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.benches.Tooltip: Benches on the hub and at each zone, always facing the play.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.shade.Tooltip: Shade for parents and children: a shelter on the hub, trees behind each zone, both or none.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.sightlines.Tooltip: No trees or bushes between the parents' hub and any play zone.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.hubTables.Tooltip: A few picnic tables just outside the parents' hub.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.wornGround.Tooltip: Paints trampled ground round each zone (permanent terrain texture).
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.paintLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's terrain layers (1–4) to paint.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.fence.Tooltip: A fence round the playground (gaps at the entrances) and a low fence round the toddler zone.
An open lawn with two small goals for ball games.
FlowerPainter.AdvPlay.Issue.NoZones: No play zone fits in this area.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Kickabout.Name: Kickabout lawn
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Kickabout.length.Too: Length of the open lawn; it is 60 % as wide.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Kickabout.Issue.Smal: The kickabout lawn was made smaller to fit the free space.
